title: Storage
search_index_desc: Stored on this device only, encrypted. Clearing it keeps your messages; the index rebuilds on the next search
other_data_desc: Contains credentials and encryption keys. Cleared on logout, not here
unavailable: This environment does not support local storage statistics
clear_hint: Only the search index is cleared. Messages, media and login state are kept
nothing_to_clear: Nothing to clear in the search index
clear_confirm_message: This clears the local search index ({events} messages, {rooms} rooms). Messages, media and login state are unaffected; the index rebuilds on the next search.
